cr_0006_refreeze.statement: CR-0006 Stage-3 re-freeze of the primary analysis-bundle provenance. The apgsk CEC2017 D10/D30/D50 per_run.csv was recovered by a validated deterministic re-derivation that reproduces the frozen summary CSVs EXACTLY, and phase6_run_analysis.py recomputed the formerly disclosed-unavailable apgsk run-level cells. Substantive data changes are confined to apgsk at CEC2017 D10/D30/D50 (run-level Wilcoxon AN-PWRUN/AN-EXP-BH, effect sizes AN-EFF A12/Cliff/BCa, success-rate AN-DESC, runtime AN-COST) plus the shared source_checksums that embed the recovered file hash; every other algorithm's statistical results are byte-identical, and the frozen summary CSVs (descriptive_stats_*, results/paper_tables/T*.csv) are unmodified. artifact_binding.csv is byte-identical (no bound exhibit source references a changed file). The six provenance files below were re-hashed; the cec2013/cec2011 source_use_log changes are run-timestamp-only (source reads and checksums for those suites are unchanged).
